cpu_scope: owned daemon/mailbox samples only; excludes CLI, harness and shutdown tail

resources.cadence: phase boundaries, after every live send, and at most once per second while polling

resources.cpu_scope: daemon/mailbox cumulative CPU since process start; last sample precedes shutdown; excludes short-lived CLI and harness CPU
resources.rss_scope: maximum observed samples, not true peak RSS; process RSS is not additive physical memory
resources.source: ps RSS and cumulative CPU TIME for exact owned native child PIDs
